item.title: The fix for compliance: Culture, tech and accountability
item.description: Only one in three orgs are effectively using data analytics to evaluate compliance, suggesting HR needs to move from merely reporting metrics to extracting insight. The post The fix for compliance: Culture, tech and accountability appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: The ‘invisible pay cut’ of return-to-office
item.description: A new report finds that mandatory full-time RTO policies are adding almost six weeks of commuting time for employees—a loss of $8,158 per employee annually. It's an impact that experts say could affect productivity, performance and, ultimately, retention. The post The ‘invisible pay cut’ of return-to-office appeared first on HR Executive.
